en.headline: Hong Kong Philharmonic stages free outdoor Symphony Under the Stars on Friday
en.dek: Music Director Tarmo Peltokoski leads the orchestra at the Central Harbourfront Event Space from 7.30 pm, with a programme that includes Saint-Saëns and a fireworks finale.
body: The Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra will perform its annual outdoor Symphony Under the Stars on Friday evening at the Central Harbourfront Event Space.

Admission is free but requires advance registration. Music Director Tarmo Peltokoski will conduct the concert, which includes Saint-Saëns’ Carnival of the Animals featuring pianist Aristo Sham, Gershwin pieces, John Williams’ Star Wars Suite and Tchaikovsky’s 1812 Overture with fireworks.

The organisers said the event is suitable for all ages and lasts about two hours including an intermission. Seats are provided, and the concert will also be streamed on the orchestra’s platforms and broadcast on RTHK television.
Registration for the public ballot closed in October. Limited tickets for visitors may still be available at designated tourist information centres on a first-come, first-served basis.

zh.headline: 港樂周五中環海濱呈獻免費「星夜交響曲」
zh.dek: 音樂總監貝托祺於晚上7時30分帶領樂團演出，曲目包括聖桑《動物嘉年華》及煙火收結的《1812序曲》。
body: 香港管弦樂團周五晚上在中環海濱活動空間舉行年度戶外音樂會「港樂・星夜・交響曲」。
入場免費但須預先登記。音樂總監貝托祺將執棒，曲目包括由鋼琴家沈靖韬演出的聖桑《動物嘉年華》、歌舒詠作品、約翰・威廉斯《星球大戰》組曲，以及以煙火結束的柴可夫斯基《1812序曲》。
主辦方表示活動適合任何年齡，全長約兩小時包括中場休息。現場設有座位，音樂會亦會在樂團平台直播並於港台電視播出。
公眾抽籤登記已於十月結束。訪港旅客仍可到指定旅客諮詢中心先到先得索取有限門票。
